<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0">
<title>LIFE HRMS — Employee 360° Master Profile | EMR</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --bg:#F3FAF4;--card:#FFF;--border:#DCE9DE;--border2:#BFD4C3;
  --txt:#152418;--txt2:#2A4030;--txt3:#5F6F63;--txt4:#8AA091;
  --navy:#1B5E20;--navy2:#2E7D32;--navy3:#256628;--navy4:#0F3D1E;
  --gold:#43A047;--gold2:#66BB6A;--gold3:#E8F5E9;--gold4:#2E7D32;
  --inc:#059669;--inc-bg:#ECFDF5;--inc-bd:#6EE7B7;--inc-dk:#065F46;
  --exp:#C62828;--exp-bg:#FEF2F2;--exp-bd:#FCA5A5;--exp-dk:#991B1B;
  --ast:#1565C0;--ast-bg:#EFF6FF;--ast-bd:#93C5FD;
  --lib:#E65100;--lib-bg:#FFFBEB;--lib-bd:#FCD34D;
  --eqt:#7C3AED;--eqt-bg:#F5F3FF;--eqt-bd:#C4B5FD;
  --cyan:#00838F;--cyan-bg:#F0F9FF;--cyan-bd:#7DD3FC;
  --pink:#BE185D;--pink-bg:#FDF2F8;--pink-bd:#F9A8D4;
  --sh:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.06);--sh2:0 4px 20px rgba(15,61,30,.12);--sh3:0 8px 40px rgba(15,61,30,.18);
}
html,body{height:100%;font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--txt)}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px;height:5px}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(15,45,94,.18);border-radius:4px}

/* ══ LAYOUT ══ */
.app-layout{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100vh;overflow:hidden}
.app-body{display:flex;flex:1;overflow:hidden}
.sidebar{width:220px;background:var(--navy4);flex-shrink:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow-y:auto;transition:width .2s}
.sidebar.collapsed{width:56px}
.main-content{flex:1;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.content-area{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:16px 20px}

/* ══ HEADER ══ */
.hdr{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#08260F,var(--navy4) 40%,#0F3D1E 75%,var(--navy));height:58px;padding:0 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 3px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.28);z-index:600;position:relative}
.hdr-logo{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold4),var(--gold2));border-radius:10px;width:40px;height:40px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;font-weight:900;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(184,134,11,.4)}
.hdr-brand{font-size:15px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.2px}
.hdr-sub{font-size:9.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);margin-top:1px}
.hdr-center{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto;position:relative}
.hdr-search{width:100%;height:36px;padding:0 14px 0 40px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff;font-size:12.5px;font-family:inherit;outline:none;transition:all .15s}
.hdr-search:focus{border-color:var(--gold2);background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(240,192,64,.15)}
.hdr-search::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.4)}
.hdr-search-icon{position:absolute;left:12px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:16px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);pointer-events:none}
.hdr-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-left:auto}
.hdr-clock{font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);text-align:right;line-height:1.6;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.hbtn{height:30px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:7px;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;font-family:inherit;transition:all .15s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.hbtn-gold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold4),var(--gold));color:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(184,134,11,.3)}
.hbtn-outline{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}
.hbtn-outline:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
.hdr-notif{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;position:relative;transition:all .15s}
.hdr-notif:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
.notif-dot{position:absolute;top:5px;right:5px;width:7px;height:7px;background:var(--exp);border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--navy4)}

/* ══ SIDEBAR ══ */
.sb-section{padding:10px 0}
.sb-section-title{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.6px;padding:4px 14px;margin-bottom:4px}
.sb-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:8px 14px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .12s;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;border-left:3px solid transparent;white-space:nowrap;user-select:none}
.sb-item:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:#fff}
.sb-item.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff;border-left-color:var(--gold2)}
.sb-item .sb-icon{font-size:16px;flex-shrink:0;width:20px;text-align:center}
.sb-item .sb-count{margin-left:auto;background:var(--exp);color:#fff;border-radius:10px;font-size:9px;padding:1px 6px;font-weight:800}
.sb-item .sb-count.gold{background:var(--gold)}
.sb-divider{border:none;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);margin:6px 14px}

/* ══ PAGES ══ */
.page{display:none}.page.active{display:block}

/* ══ DASHBOARD KPI ══ */
.kpi-mega{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px}
@media(max-width:1200px){.kpi-mega{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:900px){.kpi-mega{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.kpi-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:11px;padding:14px 16px;box-shadow:var(--sh);position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.kpi-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--sh2);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.kpi-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:4px;border-radius:11px 11px 0 0}
.kpi-active::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--inc),#10B981)}
.kpi-notice::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--lib),var(--gold2))}
.kpi-resigned::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--exp),#F87171)}
.kpi-probation::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cyan),#06B6D4)}
.kpi-confirmed::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ast),#60A5FA)}
.kpi-promotion::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold4),var(--gold2))}
.kpi-transfer::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--eqt),#A78BFA)}
.kpi-docs::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--pink),#F472B6)}
.kpi-total::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--navy),var(--navy2))}
.kpi-card-ico{font-size:24px;margin-bottom:8px}
.kpi-card-lbl{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--txt3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;margin-bottom:4px}
.kpi-card-val{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.kpi-card-sub{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--txt4);margin-top:4px}
.kpi-active .kpi-card-val{color:var(--inc)}.kpi-notice .kpi-card-val{color:var(--lib)}
.kpi-resigned .kpi-card-val{color:var(--exp)}.kpi-probation .kpi-card-val{color:var(--cyan)}
.kpi-confirmed .kpi-card-val{color:var(--ast)}.kpi-promotion .kpi-card-val{color:var(--gold)}
.kpi-transfer .kpi-card-val{color:var(--eqt)}.kpi-docs .kpi-card-val{color:var(--pink)}
.kpi-total .kpi-card-val{color:var(--navy)}

/* ══ EMPLOYEE SEARCH ══ */
.search-wrap{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy),var(--navy2));border-radius:12px;padding:20px 22px;margin-bottom:16px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.search-wrap::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:-60px;right:-60px;width:200px;height:200px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border-radius:50%}
.sw-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;margin-bottom:12px}
.sw-input-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sw-filter{height:36px;padding:0 12px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;outline:none}
.sw-filter option{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.sw-btn{height:36px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:8px;border:none;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold4),var(--gold));color:#fff;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;transition:all .15s}
.sw-results{margin-top:12px}
.sw-result-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr auto auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:9px 12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .12s;margin-bottom:6px}
.sw-result-item:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.sw-av{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.sw-name{font-weight:800;font-size:13px;color:#fff}
.sw-meta{font-size:10.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);margin-top:2px}

/* ══ EMPLOYEE LIST TABLE ══ */
.emp-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12.5px}
.emp-table th{background:var(--navy3);color:#fff;padding:9px 11px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;text-align:left;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);white-space:nowrap}
.emp-table td{padding:8px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);vertical-align:middle}
.emp-table tr:hover td{background:#EEF4FF!important;cursor:pointer}
.emp-table tr:nth-child(even) td{background:#F8FAFF}
.emp-table tr:nth-child(even):hover td{background:#EEF4FF!important}

/* ══ EMPLOYEE SUMMARY CARD ══ */
.emp-summary-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#08260F,var(--navy4) 45%,#0F3D1E);border-radius:14px;padding:0;margin-bottom:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh3)}
.esc-top{padding:18px 22px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px 1fr 1fr 200px;gap:16px;align-items:start}
.esc-pic-wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.esc-pic{width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:26px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background-size:cover;background-position:center;flex-shrink:0}
.esc-online{position:absolute;bottom:4px;right:4px;width:14px;height:14px;background:var(--inc);border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--navy4)}
.esc-upload{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);cursor:pointer;padding:2px 6px;border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius:5px;transition:all .12s;text-align:center}
.esc-upload:hover{color:var(--gold2);border-color:var(--gold2)}
.esc-name{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;margin-bottom:3px}
.esc-designation{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold2);margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.esc-meta-row{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
.esc-meta-row span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.esc-status-badge{padding:3px 10px;border-radius:12px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.3px}
.esb-active{background:rgba(5,150,105,.2);color:#6EE7B7;border:1px solid rgba(5,150,105,.35)}
.esb-resigned{background:rgba(220,38,38,.2);color:#FCA5A5;border:1px solid rgba(220,38,38,.35)}
.esb-notice{background:rgba(217,119,6,.2);color:#FCD34D;border:1px solid rgba(217,119,6,.35)}
.esb-probation{background:rgba(8,145,178,.2);color:#7DD3FC;border:1px solid rgba(8,145,178,.35)}
.esc-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.esc-stat{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:9px;padding:9px 12px;text-align:center;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.esc-stat-v{font-size:17px;font-weight:900;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#fff}
.esc-stat-l{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:2px}
.esc-quick-info{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.esc-qi{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09)}
.esc-qi-label{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;margin-bottom:3px}
.esc-qi-value{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#fff}
/* Journey bar at bottom of summary card */
.emp-journey-bar{background:rgba(0,0,0,.25);padding:12px 22px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);overflow-x:auto}
.journey-track{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;min-width:max-content}
.jt-step{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;cursor:pointer}
.jt-dot{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;border:2px solid;transition:all .15s;background:transparent;flex-shrink:0}
.jt-dot.done{background:var(--inc);border-color:var(--inc);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(5,150,105,.2)}
.jt-dot.current{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(240,192,64,.25);animation:pulse-gold 2s infinite}
.jt-dot.pending{background:transparent;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.25);color:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
@keyframes pulse-gold{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(240,192,64,.25)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(240,192,64,.1)}}
.jt-label{font-size:8.5px;font-weight:700;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);text-align:center;margin-top:4px;white-space:nowrap;max-width:60px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.jt-label.done{color:var(--inc)}.jt-label.current{color:var(--gold2)}.jt-label.pending{color:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.jt-line{flex:1;min-width:24px;height:2px;margin-bottom:20px;border-radius:1px}
.jt-line.done{background:var(--inc)}.jt-line.current{background:var(--gold);opacity:.6}.jt-line.pending{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}

/* ══ 20 TABS ══ */
.tabs-nav{background:#fff;border-bottom:2px solid var(--border);padding:0 20px;display:flex;overflow-x:auto;flex-shrink:0;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.05)}
.tabs-nav::-webkit-scrollbar{height:3px}
.tab-btn{padding:11px 14px;cursor:pointer;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--txt3);border-bottom:3px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-2px;white-space:nowrap;transition:all .15s;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;user-select:none;flex-shrink:0}
.tab-btn:hover{color:var(--navy)}
.tab-btn.active{color:var(--navy);border-bottom-color:var(--gold);font-weight:800}
.tab-btn .t-num{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(15,45,94,.1);color:var(--navy);font-size:9px;font-weight:900;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0}
.tab-btn.active .t-num{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
.tab-content{display:none;padding:16px 0}.tab-content.active{display:block}

/* ══ SECTION CARDS ══ */
.sec-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:11px;padding:0;box-shadow:var(--sh);overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:12px}
.sec-hdr{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.sec-hdr.gold{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold4),var(--gold))}
.sec-hdr.green{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--inc-dk),var(--inc))}
.sec-hdr.red{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--exp-dk),var(--exp))}
.sec-hdr.cyan{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#075985,var(--cyan))}
.sec-hdr .sh-badge{font-size:9.5px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:9px;font-weight:700;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
.sec-body{padding:14px 16px}
.field-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.field-grid-3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.f-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.f-label{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:var(--txt4);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px}
.f-val{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--txt);padding:6px 10px;background:#F8FAFF;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border)}
.f-val.highlight{background:var(--inc-bg);color:var(--inc-dk);border-color:var(--inc-bd);font-weight:700}
.f-val.gold{background:var(--gold3);color:var(--gold4);border-color:var(--gold2);font-weight:700}
.f-val.red{background:var(--exp-bg);color:var(--exp);border-color:var(--exp-bd);font-weight:700}

/* ══ CAREER TIMELINE (main, vertical with curves) ══ */
.career-timeline{position:relative;padding:4px 0 4px 54px}
.ctl-line{position:absolute;left:22px;top:8px;bottom:8px;width:4px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,#059669,#2563EB,#7C3AED,#43A047,#DC2626,#0891B2,#059669);border-radius:4px;opacity:.3}
.ctl-event{position:relative;margin-bottom:22px;animation:ctlIn .3s ease}
@keyframes ctlIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.ctl-dot{position:absolute;left:-40px;top:10px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.15);z-index:2;border:3px solid #fff;transition:all .15s;cursor:pointer}
.ctl-dot:hover{transform:scale(1.15)}
.ctl-connector{position:absolute;left:-14px;top:17px;width:14px;height:3px;border-radius:2px;opacity:.6}
.ctl-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 14px;border-left:4px solid;box-shadow:var(--sh);transition:all .15s;cursor:pointer}
.ctl-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--sh2);transform:translateX(3px)}
.ctl-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.ctl-type{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid}
.ctl-date{font-size:11px;font-family:monospace;color:var(--txt4);font-weight:700}
.ctl-title{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:4px}
.ctl-desc{font-size:12px;color:var(--txt2);margin-bottom:5px;line-height:1.5}
.ctl-meta{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:11px;color:var(--txt3)}
.ctl-meta span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
.ctl-expand{display:none;margin-top:8px;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px dashed var(--border2);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--txt2)}
.ctl-event.expanded .ctl-expand{display:block}

/* Event type colors */
.evt-joined{border-left-color:#059669!important}.evt-training{border-left-color:#2563EB!important}
.evt-confirmed{border-left-color:#059669!important}.evt-promotion{border-left-color:#43A047!important}
.evt-transfer{border-left-color:#7C3AED!important}.evt-salary{border-left-color:#43A047!important}
.evt-award{border-left-color:#D97706!important}.evt-warning{border-left-color:#DC2626!important}
.evt-leave{border-left-color:#0891B2!important}.evt-resigned{border-left-color:#DC2626!important}
.evt-rejoined{border-left-color:#059669!important}.evt-appraisal{border-left-color:#7C3AED!important}
.evt-medical{border-left-color:#0891B2!important}.evt-erp{border-left-color:#2563EB!important}
.evt-kpi{border-left-color:#7C3AED!important}.evt-manager{border-left-color:#D97706!important}

/* ══ PERFORMANCE CHARTS ══ */
.perf-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
.perf-kpi{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 14px;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.perf-kpi-val{font-size:24px;font-weight:900;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.perf-kpi-lbl{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--txt3);text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:3px}
.perf-bar-wrap{margin-bottom:10px}
.perf-bar-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:7px}
.perf-bar-lbl{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--txt2);min-width:130px}
.perf-bar{flex:1;height:8px;background:#E8EEF8;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden}
.perf-fill{height:8px;border-radius:4px;transition:width .5s ease}
.perf-bar-val{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;min-width:32px;text-align:right}
.rating-stars{display:flex;gap:3px;font-size:16px}

/* ══ SALARY TABLE ══ */
.sal-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12.5px}
.sal-table th{background:var(--navy3);color:#fff;padding:8px 11px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;text-align:left}
.sal-table td{padding:8px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.sal-table tr:hover td{background:#EEF4FF}
.sal-table tr:nth-child(even) td{background:#F8FAFF}
.sal-table tfoot td{background:var(--inc-bg);font-weight:800;color:var(--inc-dk);border-top:2px solid var(--inc-bd)}

/* ══ DOCUMENT CARDS ══ */
.doc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}
.doc-card{background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;padding:12px 14px;box-shadow:var(--sh);transition:all .15s}
.doc-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--sh2);border-color:var(--ast-bd)}
.doc-card.uploaded{border-color:var(--inc-bd);background:var(--inc-bg)}
.doc-card.expired{border-color:var(--exp-bd);background:var(--exp-bg)}
.doc-card.expiring{border-color:var(--lib-bd);background:var(--lib-bg)}
.doc-icon{font-size:26px;margin-bottom:7px}
.doc-name{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:3px}
.doc-status{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px}
.doc-status.ok{color:var(--inc)}.doc-status.miss{color:var(--exp)}.doc-status.exp{color:var(--lib)}
.doc-actions{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.doc-btn{padding:3px 8px;border-radius:6px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid;transition:all .12s;font-family:inherit}
.doc-btn-view{background:var(--ast-bg);color:var(--ast);border-color:var(--ast-bd)}
.doc-btn-upload{background:var(--inc-bg);color:var(--inc);border-color:var(--inc-bd)}
.doc-btn-exp{background:var(--lib-bg);color:var(--lib);border-color:var(--lib-bd)}

/* ══ ASSET CARDS ══ */
.asset-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px}
.asset-card{background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;padding:11px 13px;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--sh);transition:all .15s}
.asset-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--sh2)}
.asset-card.assigned{border-color:var(--ast-bd);background:var(--ast-bg)}
.asset-card.returned{border-color:var(--border2);background:#F1F5F9;opacity:.65}
.asset-icon{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:6px}
.asset-name{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:3px}
.asset-detail{font-size:10px;color:var(--txt3)}
.asset-status{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:8px;margin-top:4px;display:inline-block}
.as-assigned{background:var(--ast-bg);color:var(--ast)}.as-returned{background:#F1F5F9;color:var(--txt4)}

/* ══ ATTENDANCE ══ */
.att-calendar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:3px;margin-top:10px}
.att-day-hdr{text-align:center;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--txt4);padding:4px}
.att-day{text-align:center;padding:6px 4px;border-radius:5px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:all .12s}
.att-present{background:var(--inc-bg);color:var(--inc)}.att-absent{background:var(--exp-bg);color:var(--exp)}
.att-late{background:var(--lib-bg);color:var(--lib)}.att-half{background:var(--eqt-bg);color:var(--eqt)}
.att-holiday{background:#F1F5F9;color:var(--txt4)}.att-future{background:transparent;color:var(--txt4);opacity:.4}

/* ══ LEAVE BALANCE ══ */
.leave-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px}
.leave-card{background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;padding:12px 14px;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.leave-val{font-size:22px;font-weight:900;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.leave-lbl{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--txt4);text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:3px}

/* ══ TRAINING CARDS ══ */
.train-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;padding:11px 14px;margin-bottom:8px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:center;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.train-ico{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:20px;flex-shrink:0}
.train-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:2px}
.train-meta{font-size:11px;color:var(--txt3)}
.train-score{text-align:center}
.train-pct{font-size:18px;font-weight:900;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.cert-badge{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;margin-top:3px;display:inline-block}
.cert-yes{background:var(--inc-bg);color:var(--inc)}.cert-no{background:var(--exp-bg);color:var(--exp)}

/* ══ ERP SKILLS ══ */
.erp-skill-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.erp-skill{background:#F8FAFF;border-radius:9px;padding:11px 14px;border:1px solid var(--border)}
.erp-skill-name{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.erp-bar{height:8px;background:#E8EEF8;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:5px}
.erp-fill{height:8px;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ast),var(--eqt))}
.erp-meta{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--txt3);display:flex;justify-content:space-between}

/* ══ AUDIT TRAIL ══ */
.audit-item{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.audit-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:4px}
.audit-date{font-size:11px;font-family:monospace;color:var(--txt4);min-width:80px;flex-shrink:0}
.audit-action{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:2px}
.audit-detail{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--txt3)}
.audit-user{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ast);font-weight:700;margin-top:2px}

/* ══ WARNING/DISCIPLINARY ══ */
.warn-card{background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--exp-bd);border-radius:10px;padding:13px 15px;margin-bottom:10px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.warn-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:4px;background:var(--exp)}
.warn-type{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--exp);letter-spacing:.3px;margin-bottom:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.warn-desc{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--txt);margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:600}
.warn-meta{font-size:11px;color:var(--txt3)}
.appreciation-card{background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--gold2);border-radius:10px;padding:13px 15px;margin-bottom:10px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.appreciation-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:4px;background:var(--gold)}

/* ══ MISC UI ══ */
.badge{display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.bi{background:var(--inc-bg);color:var(--inc);border:1px solid var(--inc-bd)}
.be{background:var(--exp-bg);color:var(--exp);border:1px solid var(--exp-bd)}
.ba{background:var(--ast-bg);color:var(--ast);border:1px solid var(--ast-bd)}
.bl{background:var(--lib-bg);color:var(--lib);border:1px solid var(--lib-bd)}
.bq{background:var(--eqt-bg);color:var(--eqt);border:1px solid var(--eqt-bd)}
.bn{background:#EEF3FD;color:var(--navy);border:1px solid #BFDBFE}
.bg2{background:var(--gold3);color:var(--gold4);border:1px solid var(--gold2)}
.btn{height:32px;padding:0 13px;border-radius:7px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border:none;font-family:inherit;transition:all .12s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.btn-n{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}.btn-n:hover{background:var(--navy2)}
.btn-g{background:#F1F5F9;color:var(--txt2);border:1px solid var(--border2)}.btn-g:hover{background:#E2E8F0}
.btn-gold{background:var(--gold);color:#fff}.btn-green{background:var(--inc);color:#fff}
.btn-sm{height:26px;font-size:11px;padding:0 10px}
.toast-wrap{position:fixed;bottom:20px;right:20px;z-index:9999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.toast{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12.5px;box-shadow:var(--sh2);animation:tIn .2s ease}
.toast.tg{background:var(--inc-dk)}.toast.tr{background:var(--exp)}.toast.tgold{background:var(--gold4)}
@keyframes tIn{from{transform:translateX(60px);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
.empty-state{text-align:center;padding:28px;color:var(--txt4);font-size:12.5px}
.search-dropdown{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 6px);left:0;right:0;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:var(--sh2);z-index:500;max-height:320px;overflow-y:auto;display:none}
.search-dropdown.show{display:block}
.sd-item{padding:10px 14px;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:grid;grid-template-columns:40px 1fr auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;transition:background .1s}
.sd-item:hover{background:#EEF4FF}
.modal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(15,45,94,.55);z-index:700;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px}
.modal-overlay.show{display:flex}
.modal{background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:0;max-width:620px;width:100%;max-height:90vh;overflow-y:auto;box-shadow:var(--sh3);animation:mIn .2s ease}
@keyframes mIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.95)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.modal-hdr{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:14px 20px;border-radius:14px 14px 0 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.modal-close{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);border:none;color:#fff;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.modal-close:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.modal-body{padding:20px}
.modal-footer{padding:14px 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end}
.form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
.f-g{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}.f-lbl{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--txt3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px}
.f-inp{width:100%;height:35px;padding:0 10px;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:7px;font-size:13px;font-family:inherit;outline:none;background:#fff}
.f-inp:focus{border-color:var(--navy)}.f-sel{width:100%;height:35px;padding:0 10px;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:7px;font-size:13px;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;outline:none}
.f-ta{width:100%;padding:8px 10px;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:7px;font-size:13px;font-family:inherit;resize:vertical;min-height:60px;outline:none}
.toolbar{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.tb-sep{width:1px;height:24px;background:var(--border2);flex-shrink:0}
.note-card{background:#FFFBEB;border:1.5px solid var(--gold2);border-radius:9px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:8px}
.note-card.private{background:#FEF2F2;border-color:var(--exp-bd)}
.note-card.dir{background:var(--eqt-bg);border-color:var(--eqt-bd)}
/* Progress ring for KPI */
.progress-ring{transform:rotate(-90deg)}.progress-ring-fill{transition:stroke-dashoffset .5s ease}
@media print{.sidebar,.hdr-right,.btn,.toolbar{display:none!important}.app-layout{overflow:visible!important}.main-content{overflow:visible!important}.content-area{overflow:visible!important}}

</style>

// LIVE DATA CONNECTOR  →  Server Script API: lifescc_hrms_dashboard
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function _apiCall(mode, extra){
  var args = Object.assign({ mode: mode }, extra || {});
  // frappe.call is available on any logged-in portal/desk page
  if (typeof frappe !== 'undefined' && frappe.call){
    return new Promise(function(resolve, reject){
      frappe.call({ method:'lifescc_hrms_dashboard', args:args, type:'GET' })
        .then(function(r){ resolve(r && r.message); })
        .catch(reject);
    });
  }
  // fallback: raw fetch (works if page served under same origin)
  var qs = Object.keys(args).map(function(k){return encodeURIComponent(k)+'='+encodeURIComponent(args[k]);}).join('&');
  return fetch('/api/method/lifescc_hrms_dashboard?'+qs, {headers:{'X-Frappe-CSRF-Token':(window.frappe&&frappe.csrf_token)||''}})
    .then(function(res){return res.json();})
    .then(function(j){return j.message;});
}

function _setLoading(on){
  var el = document.getElementById('live-loading');
  if(!el){
    el = document.createElement('div');
    el.id='live-loading';
    el.style.cssText='position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;z-index:9999;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold2),var(--navy));transform-origin:left;transition:opacity .3s';
    document.body.appendChild(el);
  }
  el.style.opacity = on ? '1' : '0';
}

function loadLiveData(){
  _setLoading(true);
  // refdata for dropdowns (branches + departments)
  _apiCall('refdata').then(function(rf){
    if(rf&&rf.ok){
      var brEl=document.getElementById('el-branch');
      if(brEl&&rf.branches){brEl.innerHTML='<option value="all">All Branches</option>'+rf.branches.map(function(b){return'<option value="'+b+'">'+b+'</option>';}).join('');}
      var dEl=document.getElementById('el-dept');
      if(dEl&&rf.departments){dEl.innerHTML='<option value="all">All Departments</option>'+rf.departments.map(function(d){return'<option>'+d+'</option>';}).join('');}
    }
  });
  _apiCall('emp_full').then(function(m){
    if(!m || !m.ok || !m.employees){
      toast('Could not load live employee data','exp');
      _setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    // fill the global array IN PLACE so every existing function sees it
    EMPLOYEES.length = 0;
    m.employees.forEach(function(rec){ EMPLOYEES.push(rec); });
    enrichEmployees();              // rebuild timeline / attendance / audit
    renderDashboard();
    renderEmpList();
    _setLoading(false);
    toast('Loaded '+EMPLOYEES.length+' employees (live)','inc');
  }).catch(function(err){
    void 0;
    toast('Live data error — see console','exp');
    _setLoading(false);
  });
}

// ═══ TAB 11: ATTENDANCE ═══
function renderAttendance(e){
  var mnow=new Date();
  var ym=mnow.getFullYear()+'-'+String(mnow.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0');
  setTabContent('<div class="sec-card"><div class="sec-body" style="text-align:center;color:var(--txt3);padding:30px">Loading live attendance…</div></div>');
  _apiCall('attendance',{employee:e.id,month:ym}).then(function(m){
    var rows=(m&&m.ok&&m.rows)?m.rows:[];
    // map ERPNext Attendance -> calendar shape
    var byDay={};
    rows.forEach(function(r){
      var dnum=parseInt(String(r.attendance_date).split('-')[2],10);
      var st='present';
      if(r.status==='Absent')st='absent';
      else if(r.status==='Half Day')st='half';
      else if(r.status==='On Leave')st='holiday';
      else if(r.late_entry)st='late';
      var inT=r.custom_check_in_time?String(r.custom_check_in_time).split(' ')[1].slice(0,5):'—';
      var outT=r.custom_check_out_time?String(r.custom_check_out_time).split(' ')[1].slice(0,5):'—';
      byDay[dnum]={day:dnum,status:st,inTime:inT,outTime:outT,wh:r.working_hours};
    });
    var present=rows.filter(function(r){return r.status==='Present';}).length;
    var absent=rows.filter(function(r){return r.status==='Absent';}).length;
    var late=rows.filter(function(r){return r.late_entry;}).length;
    var half=rows.filter(function(r){return r.status==='Half Day';}).length;
    var html='<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px">'+
    [['✅ Present',present,'var(--inc)'],['❌ Absent',absent,'var(--exp)'],['⏰ Late',late,'var(--lib)'],['½ Half Day',half,'var(--eqt)']].map(function(sp){
      return'<div style="background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--sh)"><div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:900;color:'+sp[2]+'">'+sp[1]+'</div><div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--txt3);text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:3px">'+sp[0]+'</div></div>';
    }).join('')+'</div>';
    var monthName=mnow.toLocaleString('en-IN',{month:'long',year:'numeric'});
    if(!rows.length){
      html+='<div class="sec-card"><div class="sec-hdr cyan">📅 '+monthName+'</div><div class="sec-body" style="text-align:center;color:var(--txt3);padding:24px">No attendance records for '+monthName+'.</div></div>';
      setTabContent(html);return;
    }
    html+='<div class="sec-card"><div class="sec-hdr cyan">📅 '+monthName+' — Attendance Calendar (live)</div><div class="sec-body">'+
    '<div class="att-calendar">'+['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'].map(function(d){return'<div class="att-day-hdr">'+d+'</div>';}).join('');
    var daysInMonth=new Date(mnow.getFullYear(),mnow.getMonth()+1,0).getDate();
    var firstDay=new Date(mnow.getFullYear(),mnow.getMonth(),1).getDay();
    for(var i=0;i<firstDay;i++)html+='<div></div>';
    for(var day=1;day<=daysInMonth;day++){
      var rec=byDay[day];
      var dow=new Date(mnow.getFullYear(),mnow.getMonth(),day).getDay();
      if(!rec){
        var cls=dow===0?'att-holiday':'att-future';
        html+='<div class="att-day '+cls+'">'+day+'</div>';
      }else{
        var tip=rec.status==='present'?'In: '+rec.inTime+' Out: '+rec.outTime+(rec.wh?' ('+rec.wh+'h)':''):rec.status;
        html+='<div class="att-day att-'+rec.status+'" title="'+tip+'">'+day+'</div>';
      }
    }
    html+='</div></div></div>';
    setTabContent(html);
  }).catch(function(){
    setTabContent('<div class="sec-card"><div class="sec-body" style="text-align:center;color:var(--exp);padding:24px">Could not load attendance.</div></div>');
  });
}
